C318RAT.statement: Rational-obstruction companion thm:main: for p>=5 the canonical L_0L_K(3)S -> L_0L_K(2)L_K(3)S is nonzero on pi_-3; cor:strong rules out the proposed strong height-three underlying wedge, not weak unit retraction.

C318P3.statement: Prime-three companion thm:main: at p=n=3, L_2L_K(3)S_3-complete is not in the ordinary S-linear thick subcategory generated by L_0S,L_1S,L_2S; it does not assert failure of a specified unit retraction.

C318WEAKGENERAL.statement: Weak-splitting manuscript: beta_1^((p-1)^2) gives canonical completed-sphere kernels at height p for primes p>=5 and height p+1 for p>=7; a separate incompatible-descent-exponents proof is also claimed. Only its prime-five kernel is selected here.
